blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Model adaptation is typically governed by a fixed recipe, even though different update programs can produce substantially different behavioral outcomes. We introduce adaptation compilation, which reframes where, how, and to what extent a model should adapt as a joint prediction and decision problem. Rather than searching over candidate programs anew for each learning episode, a compiler learns from prior adaptations to predict a vector-valued counterfactual response surface over candidate programs—their expected effects on acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation—and selects a program before adaptation begins. Because this predicted geometry captures multiple behavioral consequences rather than a single winner or scalar score, it can be reused under different downstream priorities without retraining. Across five learning types, preferred programs vary meaningfully across episodes, and this variation is predictable from pre-adaptation information. On Llama-3.1-8B, compiler-selected programs approach exhaustive search while outperforming global and objective-specific defaults. Replication on Gemma-2-9B preserves program heterogeneity and selection headroom, but shows that exploiting this headroom requires accounting for uncertainty when departing from strong defaults. Together, these results show that adaptation search can be amortized across related learning problems, turning prior adaptation experience into a basis for deciding how future learning should occur.
blocks.zh: 模型适应通常受固定食谱的制约,尽管不同的更新程序可以产生实质性的行为结果. 我们提出适应汇编,重新界定一个模型应作为共同预测和决策问题加以调整的地点、方式和程度。 一个编译器不是为每个学习集重新搜索候选程序,而是从先前的适应中学习,以预测一个矢量值的反事实反应表面相对于候选程序,即它们对获取、转移、界限和保存的预期影响,并在适应开始前选择一个程序。 由于这个预测几何可以捕捉到多种行为后果,而不是单个赢家或标分,因此可以在不同的下游优先事项下重复使用,而无需再培训. 在五种学习类型中,首选方案在不同阶段之间差别很大,从适应前信息来看,这种变化是可以预测的。 在Llama-3.1-8B上,编译器选用的程序采用详尽无遗的搜索方法,同时优于全球和目标特定的默认. 对Gemma-2-9B的复制保留了程序异质性和选择头室,但表明利用这个头室需要在远离强烈的默认时考虑不确定性. 这些结果共同表明,在相关学习问题上,适应搜索可以摊还,将先前的适应经验转化为决定未来应如何学习的基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Current parameter-efficient methods begin from the assumption that before learning starts, one must decide where the model is allowed to change. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) modules are commonly inserted into a fixed set of attention or feed-forward projections, often uniformly across depth. The rank, placement, regularization of these modules may be tuned, but the underlying adaptation architecture is typically specified independently of the learning problem itself. Different forms of learning (such as acquiring a new fact, applying a behavioral rule, planning a multistep procedure, or inferring a causal relationship) may therefore be implemented through the same update mechanism, even though they impose fundamentally different demands on the model.
blocks.zh: 目前的参数高效方法起源于这样的假设:在开始学习之前,必须先决定模式允许在哪里改变. 低等级的适应(LORA)模块通常被插入固定的一组关注或反馈预测中,常常是跨越深度的一致. 这些模块的等级、位置和规范化可能有所调整,但基本的适应结构通常与学习问题本身无关。 因此,不同形式的学习(如获取新事实,应用行为规则,规划多步骤程序,或推断因果关系)可以通过相同的更新机制实施,尽管它们对模型提出了根本不同的要求.

blocks.en: This assumption has become increasingly difficult to justify. Different forms of learning are not equally well supported by updates to the same regions of a network ( Ramnauth and Scassellati, 2026 ) . Some learning problems are acquired most effectively through highly localized updates, while others require broader or differently positioned changes. Moreover, the update location that maximizes immediate acquisition may not be the one that best promotes generalization—or, conversely, best prevents the learned behavior from extending beyond its intended scope.
blocks.zh: 这一假设越来越难以证明。 不同形式的学习并没有得到相同区域网络的更新(Ramnauth和Scassellati, 2026年)。 一些学习问题通过高度本地化的更新得到最有效的信息,而另一些问题则需要更广泛的或不同位置的改变。 此外,尽可能扩大即时获取的更新地点可能不是促进普遍化的最佳地点,或者反之,最能防止所学到的行为超出其预期范围。

blocks.en: Recent methods partially relax fixed adaptation architecture in that they dynamically reallocate rank, prune unnecessary parameters, select modules using local sensitivity measures, or route inputs among previously learned adapters. However, these approaches tend to optimize capacity within a predefined adaptation scheme or respond to optimization signals during a single training run. They do not yet treat the adaptation architecture itself as something to be learned. We introduce this gap as adaptation compilation . That is, given the nature of an update, what parts of the model should change, what form should those changes take, and how should the resulting updates be constrained?
blocks.zh: 最近的方法部分放松了固定的适应结构,因为它们能动态地重新分配等级、prune不必要的参数、使用当地敏感性措施选择模块或在以前学习的适应器中选择路由输入。 然而,这些办法倾向于在预先确定的适应计划内优化能力,或在一次培训中应对优化信号。 他们尚未将适应结构本身视为值得学习的东西。 我们提出这一差距作为适应汇编。 也就是说,鉴于更新的性质,模型的哪些部分应当改变,这些修改应当采取什么形式,以及由此产生的更新应当如何受到限制?

blocks.en: A compiler receives a learning problem and produces an executable adaptation program. The program specifies where updates should occur, which modules should receive those updates, how much capacity each update should have, and how strongly unaffected behavior should be preserved. Adaptation is then performed only within the compiled program. Rather than adapting a model through a static configuration and evaluating its consequences afterward, the system predicts how a learning episode is expected to respond to alternative adaptation configurations and selects the configuration expected to produce the intended behavioral profile.
blocks.zh: 编译器接收学习问题并生成可执行的适应程序. 程序具体规定了更新应在哪里进行,哪些模块应接收这些更新,每次更新应具备多少能力,以及应保持多大程度的未受影响的行为. 然后只在编译程序内进行适应。 系统与其通过静态配置来调整一个模型,并评价其之后的后果,不如预测一个学习插曲是如何预期响应替代的适应配置,并选择预期生成预期行为配置的配置.

blocks.en: This matters for system reliability because such a compiler is not only efficient---avoiding exhaustive adaptation sweeps or costly diagnostics for every update---but also distinguishes whether an update was acquired, generalized appropriately, remained bounded, and preserved unrelated behavior. A lightweight system could therefore characterize an episode, predict the consequences of candidate programs, and reserve more expensive probing or explicit search for ambiguous cases. We develop this idea through six experiments: first establishing whether meaningful selection headroom exists; then testing whether adaptation outcomes can be predicted from pre-adaptation information and used to select better programs; identifying which episode–model signals matter; and finally evaluating generalization to unseen learning types and replication on a second model backbone. 1 1 1 We provide the code, dataset, experimental outputs, and supporting artifacts for reproducibility in the supplementary GitHub repository , along with the adaptcompile Python package, which exposes adaptation compilation as a reusable interface for future applications and extensions.
blocks.zh: 这对于系统可靠性很重要,因为这种编译器不仅对每次更新都进行高效的避免详尽无遗的适应扫描或昂贵的诊断,而且还区分了更新是否获得、是否得到适当的普及、是否仍受约束以及是否保留了无关的行为。 因此,轻量级系统可以确定某一事件的特点,预测候选方案的后果,并保留更昂贵的探测或明确搜索模棱两可的案件。 我们通过6个实验来发展这一想法:首先确定是否存在有意义的选择室;然后测试适应结果是否能够从适应前的信息中预测出来,并用来选择更好的程序;确定哪个插曲-模型信号很重要;最后评估通俗化到无形的学习类型,并在第二个模型主干上复制。 1,1,我们提供代码,数据集,实验输出,以及辅助文物在补充的GitHub寄存器中可复制,同时提供适应编译的Python软件包,它暴露出适应编译是未来应用和扩展的可重复使用的界面.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: Adapting a pretrained model requires two core decisions: (1) how its parameters should change, and (2) which degrees of freedom should be available for adaptation. Our work connects prior research on parameter-efficient design, automated allocation, meta-learning, and task representation by treating adaptation structure as something that can be predicted from a new learning episode.
blocks.zh: 适应预先训练好的模型需要两个核心决定:(1)其参数应如何变化,(2)适应应有何种程度的自由。 我们的工作通过将适应结构视为可以从新的学习插曲中预测的东西,将以前关于参数效率设计、自动分配、元学习和任务表现的研究联系起来。

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) restricts adaptation to a small set of trainable degrees of freedom, including adapters, prompts, selected pretrained parameters, or low-rank updates ( Houlsby et al., 2019 ; Li and Liang, 2021 ; Lester et al., 2021 ; Zaken et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2022a ) . These methods therefore require an adaptation configuration specifying where and how learning may occur. Such configurations are commonly fixed before optimization, even though effective update locations can vary across learning objectives and need not optimize acquisition, transfer, and boundedness simultaneously ( Ramnauth and Scassellati, 2026 ) . This motivates treating adaptation structure as part of the learning problem rather than solely as a manually specified hyperparameter.
blocks.zh: 参数高效的微调(PEFT)限制适应一小组可列车自由度,包括适配器,提示器,选定的预试参数,或低档更新(Houlsby等人,2019年;Li和Liang,2021年;Lester等人,2021年;Zaken等人,2022年;Hu等人,2022年a). 因此,这些方法需要一种适应配置,具体说明学习在何处和如何发生。 此类配置通常在优化前固定,尽管有效的更新位置可能因学习目标而异,不需要同时优化获取,转移和界限(Ramnauth and Scassellati, 2026). 这促使将适应结构视为学习问题的一部分,而不是仅仅作为人工指定的超参数。

blocks.en: Several approaches already make PEFT structure adaptive. Dynamic rank allocation, architecture search, and model-derived diagnostics can redistribute capacity or identify promising layers and modules ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Valipour et al., 2023 ; Mao et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2022b ; Lawton et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Saket, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These methods establish that adaptation configuration is consequential, but generally optimize structure within the target training problem, search anew for each task, or translate a predefined diagnostic into an allocation rule. Our setting instead asks whether outcomes from previous adaptations can be reused to predict the consequences of alternative configurations for a new episode before adaptation begins.
blocks.zh: 一些办法已经使PEFT结构适应性强。 动态排位分配,架构搜索,以及模型衍生的诊断可以重新分配容量或识别有希望的层和模块(张等人,2023年;瓦利普尔等人,2023年;毛泽东等人,2024年;胡等人,2022年b年;劳顿等人,2023年;周等人,2024年;徐等人,2026年;萨克特,2026年;张等人,2026年). 这些方法确定适应配置是必然的,但一般优化目标培训问题的结构,为每项任务重新搜索,或者将预先确定的诊断转化为分配规则. 我们的设定则询问能否在适应开始前重新利用以往适应的结果来预测新事件替代配置的后果。

blocks.en: This perspective connects adaptation compilation to meta-learning and per-instance algorithm selection. Meta-learning learns initializations, optimization rules, or adaptable parameter sets across tasks ( Finn et al., 2017 ; Li et al., 2017 ; Andrychowicz et al., 2016 ; Ravi and Larochelle, 2017 ; Von Oswald et al., 2021 ) , while Task2Vec and related approaches represent tasks through their interaction with a model rather than nominal task identity ( Achille et al., 2019 ; Vu et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) . Classical algorithm selection similarly uses features of a new problem instance to predict which candidate procedure will perform best ( Rice, 1976 ) . To our knowledge, these ideas have not been combined to predict the multidimensional behavioral consequences of each candidate adaptation program so that program selection can depend on the behavioral tradeoff of interest rather than directly predicting a single winner.
blocks.zh: 这个视角将适应编译与元学习和每入算法选择联系起来. Meta-learning学习初始化,优化规则,或适应性参数集跨越任务(Finn等人,2017年;Li等人,2017年;Andrychowicz等人,2016年;Ravi和Larochelle,2017年;Von Oswald等人,2021年),而Task2Vec和相关方法通过与模型而不是名义任务身份的互动来代表任务(Achille等人,2019年;Vu等人,2020年;Wang等人,2021年). 经典算法选择同样使用新问题实例的特征来预测哪个候选程序将表现最佳(Rice,1976年)。 据我们所知,这些想法还没有被综合起来,来预测每个候选适应方案的多层面行为后果,以便程序选择可以依赖于利益的行为权衡,而不是直接预测一个赢家.

blocks.zh: 3 《适应框架汇编》

4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate adaptation compilation through five questions that follow the logic of the compiler itself: whether alternative programs create meaningful selection headroom (RQ1), whether their behavioral consequences can be predicted before adaptation (RQ2), whether those predictions support better program selection (RQ3), which pre-adaptation signals enable that prediction (RQ4), and whether the learned relationships generalize beyond represented learning families (RQ5). The following setup is shared across the five corresponding experiments (Sec. 5 – 9 ).
blocks.zh: 我们通过遵循编译器本身逻辑的五个问题来评价适应汇编:替代程序是否创建有意义的选择头室(RQ1),在适应(RQ2)之前是否能够预测其行为后果(RQ2),这些预测是否支持更好的程序选择(RQ3),哪个适应前信号能够使这种预测(RQ4),以及学习关系是否概括到代表学习家族之外(RQ5). 以下设置在五个相应的实验中共享(sec.5–9).

blocks.en: Learning Episodes. We build on the benchmark introduced by Ramnauth and Scassellati (2026) , using the same latent-specification framework, example-generation procedure, and five learning objectives: lexical binding, factual association, behavioral policy learning, causal mapping, and procedural reasoning. Each latent specification defines an episode with an adaptation set and held-out evaluations for the behavioral outcomes defined in Sec. 3 ; preservation is evaluated on examples unrelated to the target adaptation. Episodes are partitioned at the latent-specification level into 400 meta-training, 100 validation, and 100 test episodes, balanced across objectives. Objective identity is not provided to the geometry predictor.
blocks.zh: 学经论. 我们以Ramnauth和Scassellati(2026年)提出的基准为基础,使用同样的潜在特性框架、实例生成程序和五个学习目标:语言约束、事实关联、行为政策学习、因果绘图和程序推理。 每个潜在规格都用一套适应措施定义一集,并对第3节中界定的行为结果进行搁置评价;对保留的评价与目标适应措施无关。 分集在潜在特异性水平上分为400个元训练,100个验证,以及100个测试集,在目标之间实现平衡. 客观身份不提供给几何预测器.

blocks.zh: 适应记录. 每个候选节目对每集进行独立执行,并在获得,转让,界限和保存时进行评估. Meta培训和验证片段使用一个适应种子;测试片段使用三个,其结果平均用来估计预期几何. 在编译器选择之前, 测试结果永远无法获得 。

blocks.en: Episode–model features. Before adaptation, we compute (1) pooled frozen hidden-state representations of the adaptation examples, (2) frozen-model target-token loss statistics, and (3) module-level probes of sensitivity, gradient magnitude, cross-example gradient agreement, and activation magnitude across module types and normalized depth. All features are computed before adaptation, and none requires training a candidate program.
blocks.zh: Episode – 模式特征. 在适应前,我们计算 (1) 集合冻结的隐藏状态对适应实例的表示, (2) 冻结模型目标托盘损失统计, (3) 模块级探测器 敏感度,梯度级,跨实例梯度协议,以及模块类型和规范深度的激活度. 所有功能在适应前进行计算,不需要培训一个候选方案。

The full episode–model representation was pre-specified as the primary representation; within it, we compare ridge regression and random-forest regression and select the model and hyperparameters by validation mean absolute error (MAE), averaged across the four behavioral outcomes. Representation ablations are evaluated separately and are not candidates for primary-model selection. The test set is held out until final evaluation.

blocks.en: 5 Experiment 1: Is Adaptation Compilation Necessary?
blocks.zh: 5 实验 1:适应汇编是否必要?

blocks.en:
Before attempting to predict adaptation geometry, we first ask whether there is a meaningful program-selection problem to solve (RQ1). We consider two prerequisites for compilation. First, configuration sensitivity asks whether alternative adaptation programs produce meaningfully different outcomes for the same episode. Second, selection headroom asks whether the preferred program varies sufficiently across episodes to justify episode-conditioned selection. We compare the episode oracle with a global-fixed policy
learned from meta-training episodes and an objective-fixed policy that selects one program per learning objective. The remaining gap between the objective-fixed policy and the oracle therefore measures headroom beyond objective identity alone.
blocks.zh:
在试图预测适应几何之前,我们首先询问是否有有意义的程序选择问题需要解决(RQ1)。 我们认为编纂工作有两个先决条件。 首先,配置敏感性询问替代适应方案是否为同一集产生有意义的不同结果. 其次,选角室询问首选节目在各集间是否变化足够大,以证明有插曲条件的选角是合理的. 我们把剧集预言与全球固定政策进行比较
学习了元训练课程和一项目标固定政策,每个学习目标选择一个方案。 因此,目标固定政策与神谕之间的剩余差距不仅仅衡量客观身份。

blocks.en:
On 100 held-out episodes, the global-fixed policy achieves mean utility 0.569 0.569 , objective-fixed selection improves this to 0.600 0.600 , and the episode oracle reaches 0.618 0.618 (Fig. 1 a).
Objective identity therefore explains substantial structure, but does not eliminate the selection problem. Specifically, objective-fixed selection remains oracle-optimal on only 64 % 64\% of episodes, compared with 41 % 41\% for the global policy. Moreover, 99 % 99\% of episodes have a unique utility-maximizing program,
and all four candidate programs are oracle-optimal for substantial subsets of episodes.
blocks.zh:
在100个搁置事件上,全球固定政策实现了平均效用0.569 0.569,目标固定选择改进为0.600 0.600,插曲甲骨文达到0.618 0.618(图1a).
因此,客观身份可以解释实质性结构,但并不能消除甄选问题。 具体地说,只有64%的64%的节目中,目标性选择仍然是最佳选择,而全球政策则只有41%。 此外,99%的99%的节目有一个独特的功能最大化程序,
而所有四个候选节目 对于大量小集来说都是最佳的

blocks.en: The remaining headroom is heterogeneous across learning objectives. It is largest for lexical binding and factual association, smaller for causal and behavioral learning, and nearly absent for procedural reasoning (Fig. 1 b). Thus, some learning regimes admit strong structural defaults, whereas others retain meaningful episode-level variation in which program best balances acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation. Additional analyses are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 其余的教学室各不相同。 其规模最大的是词汇约束力和事实联系,较小的是因果学和行为学,几乎没有程序推理(图1b)。 因此,有些学习制度承认了严重的结构性缺省,而另一些则保留了有意义的分级变化,其中方案最能平衡获取、转让、界限和保全。 附录B提供了其他分析。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Selection headroom in adaptation geometry. (A) Fraction of held-out episodes for which each adaptation program is oracle-optimal, shown by learning objective. (B) Episode-specific headroom beyond the objective-fixed policy, measured as oracle utility minus objective-fixed utility. Gray points denote episodes; black points and error bars show the mean and 95% CI. Headroom is largest for lexical binding and factual association and nearly absent for procedural reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图1:适应几何的选取室。 (A) 以学习目标显示的每个适应方案最优表现的搁置事件分数。 (B) 目标固定政策以外的特定源头室,衡量为甲骨文效用减去目标固定效用。 灰点表示事件;黑点和错误条显示平均值和95%的CI. 头室最大的是具有词汇约束力和事实联系,几乎没有程序推理。

blocks.en: 6 Experiment 2: Can Adaptation Geometry Be Predicted?
blocks.zh: 6 实验2:适应几何可以预测吗?.

blocks.en: Having established meaningful selection headroom, we next ask whether adaptation geometry can be predicted before adaptation (RQ2). For each held-out episode–program pair, the predictor estimates acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation from pre-adaptation information. The full representation uses a random forest, selected over ridge regression by validation MAE ( 0.044 0.044 vs. 0.099 0.099 ). We compare against a configuration-mean baseline and, diagnostically, an objective-conditioned mean predictor given the true learning objective.
blocks.zh: 在建立了有意义的选择室之后,我们接下来问,在适应之前是否能够预测适应几何(RQ2)。 对于每个被搁置的插曲 - 程序配对, 预测器估计获得, 转移, 界限, 以及保存在适应前信息。 完全表示使用随机林,通过验证MAE(0.044 0.044对0.099 0.099)从山脊回归上选择. 我们比较了组合-指向基线,从诊断角度来说,考虑到真正的学习目标,比较了客观条件的预测平均值。

blocks.en: On held-out episodes, the primary predictor achieves geometry MAE of 0.040 0.040 , compared with 0.238 0.238 for the configuration-mean baseline and 0.060 0.060 for the objective-conditioned diagnostic (Fig. 2 ). Predicted and observed program utilities are also strongly aligned ( r = 0.962 r=0.962 ). More importantly for compilation, the predictor preserves within-episode program ordering, reaching Spearman correlation 0.803 0.803 , pairwise ranking accuracy 87.5 % 87.5\% , and top-1/top-2 oracle recovery of 77 % 77\% / 93 % 93\% . These results show that pre-adaptation episode–model signals contain information beyond objective identity about how alternative programs will behave, including the relative ordering needed for selection. Additional per-objective analyses are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 在搁置时,主预测器的几何MAE为0.040 0.040,而配置-平均基线为0.238 0.238,客观条件诊断为0.060 0.060(图2)。 预测和观测到的程序公用设施也高度一致(r = 0.962 r = 0.962 ) 。 更重要的是,预测器在编译时保留了集成程序指令,达到了斯皮尔曼的0.803 0.803 , 双向排列精度为87.5 % 87.5 % , 顶端-2 甲骨文回收率为77 % 77% / 93% 。 这些结果显示,适应前的插曲-模型信号包含超出客观身份的信息,说明替代程序将如何运作,包括选择所需的相对顺序. 附录C提供了额外的客观分析。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Predicting adaptation geometry from pre-adaptation episode–model signals. (A) Predicted and observed balanced utility across held-out episode–program pairs. (B) Mean absolute error for acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation under the primary predictor and non-episode-conditioned baselines. (C) Within-episode program-ranking fidelity measured by Spearman correlation, pairwise ranking accuracy, and tie-aware top-1 and top-2 oracle recovery.
blocks.zh: 图 2:从适应前的插曲-模型信号中预测适应几何. (A) 预设和观察到各套节目的平衡用途。 (B) 在主要预测器和不附带先决条件的基线下取得、转让、界限和保全的平均绝对错误。 (C) 由斯皮尔曼关联度,双向排列精度,以及领带意识的顶级-1和顶级-2甲骨文恢复度所测量的全周期内程序级忠诚度.

blocks.en: 7 Experiment 3: Does Prediction Yield Better Programs?
blocks.zh: 7 实验3:预告Yield更好程序吗?.

blocks.en: We next ask whether predicted geometry supports better program selection (RQ3). Under balanced utility, the objective-fixed policy already captures much of the available selection headroom (Fig. 3 a), achieving 0.600 0.600 mean utility versus 0.618 0.618 for the exhaustive oracle. The compiler reaches 0.607 0.607 , reducing oracle regret from 0.018 0.018 to 0.011 0.011 and recovering roughly 39 % 39\% of the remaining gap. Across 100 held-out episodes, compilation improves over objective-fixed selection on 22 episodes, degrades performance on 7, and yields identical realized utility on 71 (mean paired gain = 0.0072 =0.0072 , 95% bootstrap CI [ 0.0011 , 0.0136 ] [0.0011,0.0136] ). Compiler regret remains below 0.006 for four of five learning objectives, with lexical binding the clearest remaining failure mode (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 我们接下来询问预测几何是否支持更好的程序选择(RQ3). 在平衡的效用下,目标固定政策已经掌握了大部分可供选择的主室(图3a),实现了0.600 0.600 平均效用,而详尽的甲骨文则为0.618 0.618。 编译器达到0.607 0.607,将甲骨文遗憾从0.018 0.018减少到0.011 0.011,并恢复了大约39%的余下差距. 在100个停播的节目中,汇编改进了22集的客观选择,降低了7集的性能,并在71集(平均成对收益=0.0072=0.0072,95%的靴子CI[0.001,0.0136] [0.001,0.0136])中产生相同的实际效用。 对于五个学习目标中的四个目标,编译者遗憾仍然低于0.006,其词典约束了最清晰的剩余失败模式(附录D.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Program selection from predicted adaptation geometry. (A) Realized balanced utility for global-fixed, objective-fixed, compiler, and oracle selection; values below the axis show mean oracle regret. (B) Oracle regret under alternative utility specifications, using the same predicted geometry without retraining. Percentages show tie-aware top-1 oracle recovery.
blocks.zh: 图3:从预测的适应几何中选择程序。 (A) 实现全局固定、目标固定、编译和甲骨文选择的均衡用途;轴下值显示中等甲骨文遗憾。 (B)甲骨文在替代用途规格下后悔,使用相同的预测几何而无需再培训. 百分率显示领带-领带第一甲骨文恢复.

blocks.en: Because the predictor estimates behavioral outcomes rather than a single winner, the same predicted geometry can be recompiled under different priorities without retraining. The compiler remains closer to the oracle than either fixed policy under transfer-, boundedness-, and preservation-heavy utilities (Fig. 3 b), showing that predicted geometry can support different adaptation objectives after prediction. Additional per-objective and utility-specific results are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 因为预测器估计的是行为结果而不是一个赢家,所以同样的预测几何可以在不同的优先级下重新编译,而不进行再培训. 汇编器仍然比转移、界限和保全重公用设备(图3b)下的固定政策更接近于甲骨文,表明预测几何在预测后可以支持不同的适应目标。 附录D提供了每个目标和具体公用事业的额外成果。

blocks.en: 8 Experiment 4: Which Pre-Adaptation Signals are Needed?
blocks.zh: 8 实验 4:哪种预适应 需要信号吗?

blocks.en: We next ask how much pre-adaptation information is needed to predict geometry and support program selection (RQ4). Our primary representation combines adaptation-example representations, frozen-model behavioral statistics, and module-level probes. Surprisingly, the episode-only representation performs comparably to the full representation, achieving geometry MAE of 0.0434 0.0434 versus 0.0435 0.0435 , with within-episode Spearman correlation of 0.848 0.848 and top-1 oracle recovery of 83 % 83\% .
blocks.zh: 我们接下来询问需要多少适应前信息来预测几何和支持程序选择(RQ4). 我们的主要表述结合了适应-实例表述,冷冻模式的行为统计,以及模块级探测. 出乎意料的是,只插曲代表作与全插曲代表作相仿,实现几何MAE为0.04340.0434对0.04350.0435,集内斯皮尔曼相关为0.8480.848,最高-1甲骨文恢复为83%83\%.

blocks.en: Module probes and frozen-model behavioral statistics are weaker independently, with geometry MAE of 0.053 0.053 and 0.054 0.054 , respectively. These results suggest that, in the present setting, most of the signal needed for compilation is already available in frozen representations of the learning episode. Explicit gradient and behavioral diagnostics therefore provide limited additional benefit, indicating that useful compilation may require less pre-adaptation computation than expected (Fig. 4 a). Full prediction and selection results are provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 模块探测器和冷冻模型的行为统计独立性较弱,几何MAE分别为0.0530.053和0.0540.054. 这些结果表明,在目前情况下,汇编所需的大多数信号已经存在于对学习插曲的冻结表述中。 因此,清晰的梯度和行为诊断提供了有限的额外好处,表明有用的汇编可能需要比预期的更低的适应前计算(图4a)。 附录E提供了全面的预测和选择结果。

blocks.en: 9 Experiment 5: Does Adaptation Compilation Generalize?
blocks.zh: 9 实验5:适应汇编是否通用?

blocks.en: Experiments 2–4 evaluate unseen episodes drawn from learning families represented during meta-training. We finally ask whether the learned relationship between episode representations and adaptation geometry transfers to an entirely unseen learning family (RQ5). In leave-one-family-out evaluation, one objective is excluded entirely from both training and validation, and the resulting predictor is evaluated on test episodes from that unseen family.
blocks.zh: 实验2 - 4 评估在元培训期间来自学习家庭的隐形事件。 我们最后问,插曲表述和适应几何学之间的学习关系是否转移到一个完全看不见的学习家庭(RQ5)。 在 " 一个家庭离家 " 评估中,一个目标完全被排除在培训和鉴定之外,由此产生的预测器是在来自这个看不见的家庭的测试中评估的。

blocks.en: Zero-shot family transfer is substantially more difficult than prediction for unseen episodes from represented objectives. Mean geometry MAE rises to 0.339 0.339 , within-episode Spearman correlation falls to 0.058 0.058 , and top-1 oracle recovery drops to 14 % 14\% . Correspondingly, compiler utility falls to 0.533 0.533 , below the global-fixed policy at 0.556 0.556 (Fig. 4 b). Performance is heterogeneous across families, but the overall result is that strong generalization to unseen episodes within represented learning regimes does not imply zero-shot transfer to entirely unseen forms of learning. Additional per-family results are provided in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 零射线家庭转移比从代表目标中预测未见事件要困难得多。 平均几何MAE上升至0.339 0.339 ,在集内Spearman的关联性下降到0.058 0.058 ,顶端-1甲骨文恢复率下降到14% 14\%. 相应地,编译器的效用降至0.533 0.533 ,低于全球固定政策0.556 0.556 (图 4 b). 不同家庭的表现各不相同,但总的结果是,在代表性的学习制度内,强烈地概括到看不见的情况并不意味着零射向完全看不见的学习形式转移。 附录F提供了每个家庭的额外结果。

blocks.en: These results establish an important boundary on the present form of adaptation compilation. The predictor generalizes well to new episodes within learning families represented during meta-training, but does not reliably extrapolate adaptation geometry to qualitatively unseen learning objectives. The learned mapping therefore captures structure that is more general than individual latent specifications, but remains dependent on coverage of the underlying learning regime.
blocks.zh: 这些结果为目前的适应汇编形式确定了一个重要的界限。 预测器很好地概括了元培训中代表的学习家庭的新情况,但并不能可靠地将适应几何推向质量上看不见的学习目标。 因此,所学的绘图所捕捉的结构比个别潜在规格更为笼统,但仍取决于基本学习制度的覆盖面。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Scope and boundary conditions of adaptation compilation. (A) Episode representations alone support selection comparable to the full representation, while module probes and frozen-behavior features are weaker in isolation; the outlined bar marks the primary full representation. (B) Compilation reduces oracle regret when learning families are represented during meta-training, but this advantage reverses when an entire family is withheld (LOFO). (C) Compilation improves over objective-fixed defaults on Llama, whereas on Gemma direct selection from predicted geometry does not improve over the strong objective-fixed policy despite remaining episode-level headroom. Error bars show 95% episode-bootstrap CIs where applicable. Lower oracle regret is better.
blocks.zh: 图4:适应汇编的范围和边界条件。 (A) 仅Episode表示支持与完全表示相当的选择,而模块探测器和冷冻行为特性则在孤立中较弱;概述的条表示主要的完全表示。 (B) 当学习家庭在元培训期间得到代表时,汇编会减少甲骨文遗憾,但当整个家庭被扣(LOFO)时,这一优势就会逆转。 (C) 汇编改进了Llama上的目标定值默认,而Gemma上从预测几何中直接选择的目标定值没有改进,尽管仍然保留了插曲级头室。 错误栏显示95%的插曲-插曲 CI 。 下层先知的悔恨更好

blocks.en: 10 Experiment 6: Does the Case for Compilation Reproduce Across Backbones?
blocks.zh: 10 实验 6: 汇编在背骨上复制的理由吗?

blocks.en: Experiments 1–5 establish adaptation compilation on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, but adaptation geometry is inherently model-dependent. Ramnauth and Scassellati (2026) finds broadly consistent localization signatures across models, alongside substantial model-specific variation and particular sensitivity in Gemma to Llama-calibrated adaptation budgets. We therefore repeat the compiler pipeline on Gemma-2-9B-IT, independently recalibrating the optimization schedule while holding the program library and evaluation protocol fixed. The predictor is trained only on Gemma adaptation records, testing replication of the compilation principle rather than zero-shot transfer from Llama.
blocks.zh: 实验1–5在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上建立适应汇编,但适应几何本质上依赖模型. Ramnauth和Scassellati(2026年)发现各模型的本地化特征大体一致,同时Gemma对Llama校准的适应预算有很大的模型差异和特别敏感。 因此,我们重复Gemma-2-9B-IT上的编译器管道,独立调整优化时间表,同时将程序库和评价协议固定下来. 预测器只接受Gemma适应记录的培训,测试复制编译原理,而不是从Llama进行零镜头传输.

blocks.en: On Gemma, the best fixed program is full-stack. Objective-specific defaults select full-stack for behavioral, factual, and procedural learning, middle for causal mapping, and late for lexical binding; only the causal default matches Llama. Yet no program dominates held-out episodes: across 100 test episodes, oracle selections are 40% full, 31% middle, 23% late, and 6% early. The best fixed program achieves .436 mean utility, versus .461 for the episode-wise oracle; objective-specific defaults reach .438 but retain .023 mean regret. Thus, adaptation geometry changes across backbones, but substantial episode-level selection headroom remains even after conditioning on learning type.
blocks.zh: 在Gemma上,最好的固定程序是全速运行. 目标特定的默认选择了行为学,事实学,程序学学习的全集,因果映射的中间部分,以及词典绑定的后期;只有因果默认匹配Llama. 然而,没有任何一个节目在被搁置的节目中占据主导地位:在100个测试节目中,甲骨文选集有40%是完整的,31%是中间的,23%是迟到的,6%是早期的。 最佳固定程序实现.436平均功用,相对于分集甲骨文的461;特定目标默认达到438,但保留0.023平均遗憾. 因此,适应几何在骨干上有所变化,但即使在对学习类型进行条件调整之后,实质性的插曲级选择头室仍然保留。

blocks.en: Recovering this headroom is more difficult for Gemma. The learned compiler achieves .435 mean utility versus .461 for the oracle, with .026 regret, 42% oracle recovery, and 73% top-2 recovery. Its aggregate performance is comparable to, but does not exceed, the global-fixed (.436) or objective-fixed (.438) baselines (Fig. 4 c). The shortfall is concentrated, not uniform; the compiler largely recovers strong defaults for behavioral, causal, and factual episodes, with most loss arising in procedural reasoning and a smaller deficit in lexical binding. In these cases, small predicted differences between candidate programs can trigger a switch even when the realized advantage is uncertain.
blocks.zh: 找回这个头室对Gemma来说比较困难. 所学编译器实现435个平均功用,对甲骨文则达到461个,有0.026个遗憾,甲骨文恢复42%,上-2恢复73%. 其总性能与总定(436)或目标定(438)基线(图4c)相当,但不超过总定(436). 短缺是集中的,不是统一的;编译器在行为,因果和事实事件上基本恢复了强烈的违约,在程序推理上产生的损失最多,在词汇约束上的赤字较小. 在这种情况下,即使实现的优势不确定,候选人方案之间的小的预测差异也可能触发开关.

blocks.en: Gemma sharpens rather than weakens the case for compilation. Program heterogeneity and episode-level oracle headroom persist across backbones, but exploiting that headroom requires knowing when a predicted advantage over a strong default is reliable. On Llama, direct selection from predicted geometry improves over fixed policies; on Gemma, the same rule sometimes acts on small, noisy margins. This suggests an additional design requirement for adaptation compilers. Program selection should account not only for predicted geometry, but also for uncertainty in the decision to depart from a robust default.
blocks.zh: Gemma 磨损而不是削弱汇编的范畴。 方案异质性和插曲级甲骨文头室在骨干上持续存在,但利用该头室需要知道预测的优势是否可靠。 在Llama,从预测的几何学上直接选择比固定政策要好;在Gemma,同样的规则有时会在小的,吵闹的边际上起作用. 这表明适应编译器需要额外的设计要求. 方案选择不仅应顾及预测的几何,还应顾及在决定脱离强烈违约时的不确定性。

blocks.en: 11 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Adaptation compilation begins from a methodological mismatch: structural choices—where to update, which modules to expose, and how much capacity to allocate—are typically fixed before knowing how a given learning episode will respond. Prior work shows that these choices induce distinct behavioral profiles across learning objectives ( Ramnauth and Scassellati, 2026 ) , but identifying those profiles ordinarily requires running the very adaptations one hopes to choose among. We ask whether this search can instead be amortized across prior adaptation experience.
blocks.zh: 适应汇编从方法上的不匹配开始:结构选择——在何处更新、哪些模块将曝光、分配能力如何——通常在知道特定学习事件将如何应对之前就固定下来。 先前的研究表明,这些选择吸引了不同的行为特征,贯穿于学习目标(Ramnauth和Scassellati, 2026年),但确定这些特征通常需要运行人们希望选择的适应性。 我们问,是否可以通过以往的适应经验来进行这一搜索。

blocks.en: Our results show that it can, but also clarify the conditions under which doing so is useful. On Llama, approximately budget-matched programs produce meaningfully different outcomes across episodes, those differences are predictable before adaptation, and selecting from predicted geometry substantially closes the gap to exhaustive search while outperforming global and objective-specific defaults. The same predictions can also be reused under different behavioral priorities because the compiler estimates acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation rather than directly predicting a single winning program. Experiment 6 shows that the case for compilation reproduces on Gemma: adaptation geometry changes across backbones, yet substantial episode-level selection headroom remains. At the same time, direct selection from predicted geometry is less reliable on Gemma, revealing that headroom alone is insufficient; a useful compiler must also know when a predicted advantage over a strong default is trustworthy.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,它可以,但也澄清了这样做有用的条件。 在Llama, 大致预算匹配的方案在不同时期产生有意义的不同结果, 这些差异在适应之前是可以预测的, 从预测几何学中选择大大缩小差距, 到详尽无遗的搜索, 而同时优于全球和目标特定的默认。 同样的预测也可以在不同的行为优先级下重复使用,因为编译器估计的是获取,转移,定界,以及保存,而不是直接预测一个单一的胜出程序. 实验6显示,编译案例在Gemma上重现:适应几何变化跨骨干,然而大量插曲级选择头室仍然存在. 同时,从预测几何学中直接选择在Gemma上并不可靠,揭示出单是头室是不够的;一个有用的编译器也必须知道预测的优势相对于强烈的默认何时是值得信赖的.

blocks.en: 11.1 Adaptation as a Prediction and Decision Problem
blocks.zh: 11.1 作为预测和决定问题的适应

blocks.en: These results suggest treating the adaptation procedure itself as part of the learning problem. Rather than applying one fixed fine-tuning recipe, adaptation geometry makes the update program a decision variable because alternative programs induce different tradeoffs among acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation. The compiler separates two questions that are often conflated: what will happen if the model is adapted this way? and which of those outcomes is preferred?
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,适应程序本身是学习问题的一部分。 适应几何方法不是应用一种固定的微调配方,而是使更新程序成为一个决定变量,因为替代程序在获取、转移、界限和保存之间诱导不同的权衡。 编译器将经常被拼凑的两个问题分开:如果模型被这样调整,会发生什么? 哪些结果更可取?

blocks.en: This separation is useful because there need not be a universally best program. Predicting the full geometry preserves behavioral tradeoffs and allows the same predictions to be re-evaluated under different utilities without retraining. It also changes where search cost is paid. Exhaustive configuration search repeats multiple adaptations for every new episode, whereas compilation learns from prior interventions and reuses that experience. Constructing the initial geometry dataset remains expensive, but future adaptation decisions can be made from pre-adaptation information before executing only the selected program.
blocks.zh: 这种分离是有用的,因为不需要一个普遍最好的方案。 预测完整的几何可以保持行为上的权衡,并允许在不同公用事业下重新评价同样的预测,而无需再培训。 它还改变支付搜索费用的地点。 耗尽的配置搜索重复了每个新剧集的多个改编,而编译则从先前的干预中吸取教训,并重用这种经历. 构建初始几何数据集依然昂贵,但未来的适应决定可以在仅执行所选程序之前通过预适应信息做出.

blocks.en: 11.2 What Determines an Adaptation Program?
blocks.zh: 11.2 如何确定适应方案?

blocks.en: The experiments suggest that adaptation structure is neither purely global nor reducible to learning-objective identity. Objective-conditioned defaults are strong, but oracle programs continue to vary within objectives, and episode-conditioned prediction improves beyond those defaults on Llama. The relevant unit for adaptation therefore lies between a universal fine-tuning recipe and a categorical task-level rule.
blocks.zh: 这些实验表明,适应结构既不是纯粹的全球性的,也不是可被降低到学习-客观的特性。 目标有条件的缺省情况很严重,但甲骨文方案在目标范围内继续有差异,而事件有条件的预测比Llama上的缺省情况有所改善。 因此,适应工作的相关单位在通用的微调办法和绝对的任务级别规则之间。

blocks.en: Experiment 4 suggests that adaptation compilation may be cheaper than its most general formulation implies. Frozen representations of the learning episode alone recover nearly all of the predictive performance of the full episode–model representation, despite omitting behavioral statistics and module-level probes. In this setting, explicit diagnostics therefore appear better suited for uncertain or difficult cases than as a prerequisite for every compilation decision.
blocks.zh: 试验4表明,适应汇编可能比最一般的表述要便宜。 尽管忽略了行为统计和模块层面的探针,但仅仅对学习剧集的冻结表述就几乎恢复了整个剧集的预测性表现 — — 模型表述。 因此,在这种情况下,明确的诊断似乎更适合不确定或困难的病例,而不是作为每个汇编决定的先决条件。

blocks.en: Experiment 6 adds a second source of variation: the mapping from learning problems to useful programs is model-dependent. Gemma retains clear episode-level heterogeneity even though its objective-level program preferences differ substantially from Llama. Adaptation geometry should therefore be understood as a property of the interaction among episode, model, and program rather than as a fixed localization map. Accordingly, these results should not be interpreted as evidence of strict modularity; depth and module placement are functional intervention variables, not canonical locations where particular forms of knowledge reside.
blocks.zh: 实验6增加了第二个变异源:从学习问题到有用的程序的绘图是依赖模型的. Gemma保留了明显的插曲级别异质性,尽管其目标级别程序偏好与Llama有很大不同. 因此,应把适应几何理解为插曲、模型和程序之间相互作用的属性,而不是固定的本地化地图。 因此,这些结果不应被解释为严格的模块化证据;深度和模块设置是功能干预变量,而不是特定形式知识所在的空洞地点。

blocks.en: 11.3 When Should a Compiler Trust Its Prediction?
blocks.zh: 11.3 编纂者信托机构何时应作出预测?

blocks.en: The family- and backbone-generalization experiments expose an important boundary on the current formulation. In leave-one-family-out evaluation, performance degrades when an entire form of learning is absent from meta-training: geometry error increases, program rankings become less reliable, and compilation can underperform a fixed structural policy. The compiler therefore learns regularities over adaptation problems represented in its experience rather than a universal mapping from arbitrary learning problems to update programs.
blocks.zh: 家庭和骨干通用实验暴露了当前配方的重要界限. 在休假-一个家庭-退出评价中,当元培训中缺少一种完整的学习形式时,性能会退化:几何误差增加,程序排名变得不可靠,编译可能使固定的结构政策表现不佳. 因此,编译器学习的是周期性,而不是其经验中反映的适应问题,而不是从任意的学习问题中进行普遍绘图,以更新程序。

blocks.en: Gemma reveals that, even when the learning families are represented and episode-level headroom remains, small errors in predicted program differences can make a deterministic argmax selector worse than a strong default. This effect is not uniform—most of the Gemma shortfall arises from lexical and especially procedural episodes, where small predicted advantages trigger program switches that do not consistently improve realized utility. Thus, successful compilation requires calibrated confidence in whether the predicted difference between competing programs is large enough to act on.
blocks.zh: Gemma透露,即使学习家庭有代表,且片段级头室仍然存在,预测程序差异中的小错误可能会使决定性的argmax选择器比强烈的默认更糟糕. 这种效果并不统一——Gemma的短缺大部分来自词汇学,特别是程序学事件,在这种事件中,小的预期优势触发了程序开关,而这种开关并没有一贯地提高实际的效用。 因此,成功的编译需要校准对竞合程序之间预测的差异是否足够大以采取行动的信心。

blocks.en: This suggests a natural extension from geometry prediction to confidence-aware compilation . A compiler could retain a robust global or objective-specific default when candidate programs are predicted to be nearly equivalent, and deviate only when the expected improvement is sufficiently large or well supported. Out-of-family detection, predictive uncertainty, and targeted empirical search could serve the same purpose when the compiler encounters unfamiliar adaptation problems. We do not introduce such a rule post hoc here; rather, the Gemma results identify it as an additional design requirement for future compilers.
blocks.zh: 这说明从几何预测到自信汇编的自然延伸。 编译器可以在预测候选程序接近等值时保留强有力的全球或特定目标默认,只有在预期改进足够大或得到充分支持时才偏离。 在编译器遇到不熟悉的适应问题时,家庭外探测、预测性不确定性和有针对性的经验性搜索可以起到同样的作用。 我们在此不提出这种事后规则;相反,Gemma结果将它确定为未来编译者的额外设计要求。

blocks.en: 11.4 Practical Scope and Limitations
blocks.zh: 11.4 实际范围和限制

blocks.en: Adaptation compilation is most attractive in settings involving many repeated but heterogeneous updates, where exhaustive per-episode tuning is impractical but repeatedly applying a poorly matched strategy can accumulate substantial cost. A system could maintain a library of feasible adaptation programs, characterize a new episode before training, and either execute the predicted program or fall back to a structural default or targeted search when confidence is low. Our representation ablations suggest that this decision does not always require expensive model diagnostics; richer probes could instead be reserved for uncertain cases.
blocks.zh: 适应汇编在涉及许多反复但内容多样的更新的环境下最有吸引力,在这种环境中,详尽无遗的每集调试不切实际,但反复采用不匹配的战略可能积累大量成本。 一个系统可以维持一个可行的适应程序库,在培训前描述一个新插曲的特征,或者执行预言的程序,或者在信心不足时恢复到结构默认或定向搜索. 我们的陈述表明,这一决定并不总是需要昂贵的模型诊断;更丰富的探测器可以留给不确定的病例。

blocks.en: The present study nevertheless uses a small and structured program space (four LoRA configurations across five controlled learning objectives). Real adaptation spaces may include finer-grained layer choices, heterogeneous rank allocation, optimizer settings, multiple adaptation mechanisms, and sequential or mixed objectives. Compilation also amortizes search rather than eliminating it: supervision still requires executing candidate programs on prior episodes, and adaptation outcomes remain stochastic. Scaling this approach will then require both richer program representations and more selective acquisition of adaptation experience.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,本研究还是使用了一个结构化的小型程序空间(跨越五个受控学习目标的四种LORA配置). 真正的适应空间可能包括更精细的层层选择、不同的等级分配、优化器设置、多种适应机制以及顺序或混合目标。 汇编还分期摊销而不是取消搜索:监督仍需要执行以前各期的候选方案,而适应结果仍然有条理。 扩大这一办法将要求更丰富的方案说明和更有选择地获得适应经验。

blocks.en: Our broader conclusion is that adaptation itself can become learnable. Prior adaptation episodes contain information about how future learning should be carried out. Our results show that this information can support effective program selection within represented regimes, while the Gemma and leave-one-family-out experiments clarify two important limits: adaptation geometry is model-dependent, and predicted advantages must be reliable enough to justify departing from strong defaults. These boundaries turn adaptation compilation from a fixed recipe into a conditional decision problem—one that must reason not only about which program appears best, but also when that prediction is worth trusting.
blocks.zh: 我们更广泛的结论是,适应本身可以学习。 以往的适应事件包含关于如何开展未来学习的信息。 我们的结果显示,这种信息可以支持在代表制度内有效的程序选择,而Gemma和leave-one-family-out的实验澄清了两个重要的限度:适应几何学是依赖模型的,预测的优点必须足够可靠,以证明有理由脱离强烈的默认. 这些界限将适应汇编从固定的食谱变成有条件的决定问题——它不仅必须说明哪个方案看起来最好,而且当这一预测值得信任时。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies methods for selecting adaptation programs for large language models based on prior adaptation experience. The experiments do not involve human subjects or the collection of personal or sensitive data. The proposed framework is intended as a methodological tool for understanding and improving how models are adapted to new learning objectives. Like other methods that improve the efficiency or precision of model adaptation, adaptation compilation is potentially dual-use: the same mechanisms that enable more targeted acquisition and preservation of desired behaviors could, in principle, be applied toward undesirable objectives. Our method does not provide guarantees regarding the safety, fairness, or downstream behavior of an adapted model, and the controlled evaluation objectives studied here should not be interpreted as such guarantees. Deployment in consequential settings would therefore require application-specific evaluation, appropriate safeguards, and consideration of the properties and limitations of the underlying model.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了根据以往适应经验选择大型语言模型适应方案的方法。 这些实验不涉及人类主体或收集个人或敏感数据。 拟议框架旨在作为一种方法工具,用以了解和改进如何使模型适应新的学习目标。 与提高模型适应效率或精确性的其他方法一样,适应汇编可能具有双重用途:同样能够更有针对性地获取和保持理想行为的机制原则上可以适用于不良目标。 我们的方法不能保证一个经过调整的模型的安全、公平或下游行为,在此研究的控制评价目标不应被解释为这种保证。 因此,在相应情况下的部署需要针对具体应用的评估、适当的保障以及考虑基本模型的特性和局限性。

blocks.en: Appendix A Optimization Schedule Calibration
blocks.zh: 附录A 优化时间表校准

blocks.en: Because each adaptation episode contains a single latent specification, we calibrate the optimization schedule separately for this single-specification regime before comparing adaptation configurations. The purpose of this calibration is to ensure that subsequent differences in adaptation geometry are not artifacts of systematic undertraining.

blocks.en: We use five meta-training episodes from each of the five learning objectives ( 25 25 episodes total) and adapt each episode using the unconstrained full-stack LoRA configuration. blocks.en: Appendix B Experiment 1: Characterizing Selection Headroom
blocks.zh: 附录B 1: 挑选室的特征

blocks.en: The main text establishes that alternative adaptation programs induce meaningful selection headroom on held-out episodes. Here, we provide the full objective-level results, characterize the separation between oracle-optimal programs, and examine robustness to adaptation stochasticity. All headline test results use the same 100 held-out episodes reported in the main text, with each configuration’s behavioral outcomes averaged across three adaptation seeds.
blocks.zh: 主文规定,替代性适应方案在搁置的事件中引领有意义的选择。 在这里,我们提供了完整的客观层面的结果,描述甲骨文-优化方案之间的分离特征,并研究适应的稳健性。 所有头条测试结果都使用正文中报告的相同的100个搁置事件,每个配置的行为结果平均分为三个适应种子.

blocks.en: B.1 Selection Headroom by Learning Objective
blocks.zh: B.1 按学习目标划分的甄选室

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the full selection results by learning objective. The global-fixed program is selected using all meta-training episodes, while the objective-fixed policy selects one program per learning objective using only meta-training episodes. The episode oracle selects the highest-utility program independently for each held-out episode.
blocks.zh: 表2按学习目标报告全部甄选结果。 全局固定程序是使用所有元培训插播选择的,而目标固定政策则只使用元培训插播选择每个学习目标一个程序. 插曲甲骨文为每个被搁置的插曲独立选择最高实用性程序.

blocks.en: Table 2: Selection headroom by learning objective. Utilities are measured on held-out test episodes. Global- and objective-fixed programs are selected using meta-training data only. Regret is measured relative to the per-episode oracle, and “Opt.” denotes the fraction of episodes on which the corresponding fixed policy is oracle-optimal.
blocks.zh: 表2:按学习目标分列的选择室。 水电费按停产试验情况计量。 全球和目标固定方案仅使用元培训数据选定。 与每个周期的甲骨文相比,对遗憾进行了衡量,“Opt”表示对应的固定政策是甲骨文-优化的一小部分。

blocks.en: Objective conditioning accounts for a substantial portion of program preference, reducing mean regret from 0.049 0.049 under the global-fixed policy to 0.018 0.018 . However, the magnitude of the remaining episode-specific headroom differs considerably across learning objectives. Lexical binding and factual association retain the largest objective-to-oracle gaps, whereas procedural reasoning admits a nearly universal middle-depth default. In the latter case, the objective-fixed policy is oracle-optimal on 95 % 95\% of held-out episodes and differs from the oracle by less than 0.001 0.001 utility on average.
blocks.zh: 客观条件在方案偏好中占很大比例,将平均遗憾从全球固定政策的0.049 0.049减少到0.018 0.018。 然而,其余各集的会议室规模因学习目标而大不相同。 具有逻辑约束力和事实联系保留了最大的客观对甲骨文差距,而程序推理则承认了几乎普遍的中间深度违约。 在后一种情况下,目标固定政策对95%的95+%的被搁置事件是最佳的,与甲骨文不同,平均不到0.0010.001。

blocks.en: B.2 Oracle Programs and Winner Separation
blocks.zh: B.2 甲骨文方案和胜者分离

Across all 100 test episodes, middle-depth adaptation is oracle-optimal most frequently, but every candidate program is preferred for a nontrivial subset of episodes.

blocks.en: B.3 Robustness to Adaptation Stochasticity
blocks.zh: B.3 适应性强性

blocks.en: Adaptation outcomes also vary across optimization runs. To characterize this variability directly, we analyze a stratified subset of 20 held-out episodes for which all four candidate programs were independently adapted under three random seeds. Our headline test geometry averages three seeds for all 100 held-out episodes. Here, for each episode–configuration pair, we measure the variation in utility across seeds and examine whether the identity of the oracle-optimal program remains stable (Fig. 6 ).
blocks.zh: 适应结果也因优化而异。 为了直接描述这种变异性,我们分析一个分层的20个搁置事件,所有四个候选程序都是在三个随机种子下独立调整的。 我们的头条测试几何平均有3个种子 所有100个被搁置的片段。 在这里,对于每集的配置配对,我们测量不同种子的效用变化,并检查神谕-优化程序的身份是否保持稳定(图6)。

blocks.en: Adaptation stochasticity is non-negligible: the mean within-configuration standard deviation in utility is 0.028 0.028 , and only 40 % 40\% of episodes retain the same unique oracle winner across all three individual seeds. A less restrictive, tie-aware criterion finds at least one common oracle configuration across all seeds for 55 % 55\% of episodes. These results motivate defining adaptation geometry in terms of expected behavioral outcomes rather than the realization of a single optimization run.
blocks.zh: 适应的切变性是不可忽略的:在功用中,平均的配置内标准偏差为0.028 0.028,只有40%的40%的赛事在所有三个个体种子中保留了相同的独有的神谕胜者. 一个限制性较弱、领带意识差的标准发现,对于55%的55%的种子,在所有种子中至少有一个共同的甲骨文配置。 这些结果激励着从预期的行为结果而不是实现单一优化运行的角度定义适应几何.

blocks.en: Importantly, selection headroom persists after averaging over this stochasticity. On the robustness subset, the global-fixed, objective-fixed, and episode-oracle utilities are 0.581 0.581 , 0.605 0.605 , and 0.621 0.621 , respectively. The resulting objective-to-oracle regret remains 0.016 0.016 , and the objective-fixed policy is oracle-optimal on only 60 % 60\% of episodes.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,在平均时间过长之后,挑选室仍然保留。 在稳健性子集中,全球固定、目标固定和插曲功能分别为0.581 0.581、0.605 0.605和0.621 0.621。 其结果是目标对甲骨文的遗憾仍然是0.016 0.016,目标定型政策对只有60%的六成事件是最佳的。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Adaptation stochasticity across programs. (A) Variation in utility across three adaptation seeds for each episode–program pair. (B) Stability of the oracle-optimal program across seeds, using both strict unique-winner and tie-aware criteria.
blocks.zh: 图6:各方案的适应性。 (A) 每集节目的三种适应种子的实用性变化。 (B) 整个种子的甲骨文-最佳方案的稳定,同时采用严格的独特赢家和领带意识标准。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Configuration sensitivity across adaptation outcomes. Acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation under each budget-matched adaptation program, grouped by learning objective. Values summarize held-out test episodes using seed-averaged outcomes.
blocks.zh: 图7:适应结果的配置敏感性。 在每个预算相对应的适应方案下,按学习目标分类,获得、转移、约束和保全。 价值利用种子平均结果总结了搁置的试验事件。

blocks.en: B.4 Configuration Sensitivity Across Behavioral Outcomes
blocks.zh: B.4 组合对行为结果的敏感性

blocks.en: Selection utility compresses four distinct behavioral criteria into a single scalar. To verify that program sensitivity is not restricted to aggregate utility, Fig. 7 decomposes adaptation outcomes into acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation. Alternative programs induce distinct behavioral tradeoffs across these dimensions, providing the outcome-level variation from which the selection differences reported in the main text arise.
blocks.zh: 选择工具将四个不同的行为标准压缩成单一的scalar. 为了核实程序敏感性不仅限于聚合效用,图7将适应结果分解为获取、转让、界限和保全。 替代方案在这些方面引起不同的行为权衡,提供结果层面的差异,从而产生正文中所报告的选择差异。

blocks.en: Appendix C Experiment 2: Predicting Adaptation Geometry
blocks.zh: 附录C 实验 2: 预测适应几何

blocks.en: We select the predictor using validation mean absolute error averaged across acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation. The candidate models are ridge regression and random-forest regression; validation selects the random forest ( 0.044 0.044 MAE, compared with 0.099 0.099 for ridge). The selected predictor uses 300 trees, unrestricted depth, a minimum leaf size of one, and random seed 2026. Model selection and hyperparameter choice use only meta-training and validation episodes.
blocks.zh: 我们使用验证方法来选择预测器 是指在获取、转移、界限和保存方面平均出现的绝对错误。 候选模型为山脊回归和随机-森林回归;验证选择随机森林(0.044 0.044 MAE,而山脊为0.099 0.099). 选定的预测器使用300棵树,无限制的深度,最小的叶片尺寸为1,随机种子2026. 模型选择和超参数选择只使用元训练和验证事件.

blocks.en: The aggregate prediction results in Sec. 6 obscure substantial variation across learning objectives. Table 4 , depicted as Fig. 8 , therefore evaluates the same frozen geometry predictor separately within each objective. Prediction error is lowest for behavioral episodes and remains relatively low for causal, factual, and procedural episodes, while lexical binding is markedly more variable and contains the largest-error episodes. The same distinction appears in program-ranking fidelity: predicted geometry preserves program order particularly well for behavioral, causal, and procedural episodes, whereas factual and lexical episodes are more difficult to rank. Thus, the aggregate performance of the predictor is not attributable to a single learning family, although the reliability of episode-level geometry prediction differs across objectives.
blocks.zh: 总的预测结果为第6节,模糊了学习目标之间的巨大差异。 因此,如图8所示,表4在每一目标内分别评价相同的冷冻几何预测器。 预测性错误对于行为事件来说是最低的,对于因果关系,事实性,和程序性事件来说仍然相对较低,而词典约束则明显更具可变性,包含最大的-错误事件. 同样的区别出现在程序排序的忠诚性中:预测几何学会特别有利于行为、因果和程序事件维护程序秩序,而事实事件和词汇事件则更难分类。 因此,预测器的总性能不归于一个单一的学习家族,尽管各目标间插曲级几何预测的可靠性不同.

Spearman correlation and pairwise accuracy measure agreement between predicted and observed program rankings within each episode. The same primary predictor is evaluated across all objectives without access to objective identity.

Gray points denote held-out episodes and black markers indicate means with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. blocks.zh: 附录D 试验 3:评估方案选择

blocks.en: These analyses clarify where compilation improves on structural defaults and how reusable the predicted geometry remains under changing behavioral priorities.
blocks.zh: 这些分析澄清了汇编在结构缺省方面的改进之处,以及预测几何在不断变化的行为优先事项下如何可重复使用。

blocks.en: D.1 Selection by learning objective
blocks.zh: D.1 通过学习选择目标

blocks.en: Table 5 , depicted as Fig. 9 , decomposes balanced-utility selection performance by learning objective. The compiler substantially reduces oracle regret relative to the global-fixed policy across behavioral, causal, factual, and lexical episodes, and approaches the oracle particularly closely for behavioral and causal learning. Procedural reasoning already admits a strong fixed structural default, leaving little headroom for episode-conditioned selection.
blocks.zh: 表5(图9)按学习目标分解平衡-实用性选择业绩。 编译器在行为、因果、事实和词典事件方面大大降低了与全球固定政策相比的甲骨文遗憾,并特别接近甲骨文用于行为和因果学习。 程序推理已经承认了强烈的固定结构默认,留下了小的首室用于设定插曲条件的选择.

blocks.en: Table 5: Program selection by learning objective. Realized utility and oracle regret are reported for the global-fixed, objective-fixed, and compiler policies. Top-1 denotes the fraction of held-out episodes for which each policy selects an oracle-optimal program.
blocks.zh: 表5:按学习目标分列的方案选择。 据报告,全球固定、目标固定和汇编政策已实现效用和甲骨文遗憾。 Top-1表示每个策略选择一个oracle-opteral 程序时被搁置的片段.

blocks.en: Lexical binding is the clearest exception to the general improvement over the objective-fixed policy. Although the compiler selects an oracle-optimal program on 65 % 65\% of lexical episodes, matching the objective-fixed policy, its mean realized utility is slightly lower ( 0.746 0.746 versus 0.751 0.751 ) because its mistakes occur on higher-regret episodes. This is consistent with the greater lexical prediction error observed in Appendix C . By contrast, factual association retains substantial objective-level headroom and benefits strongly from episode-conditioned selection, with regret decreasing from 0.027 0.027 to 0.006 0.006 .

blocks.en: D.2 Paired comparison with objective-fixed selection
blocks.zh: D.2 与目标选择的比较

blocks.en: Across all 100 held-out episodes, the compiler improves realized utility over the objective-fixed policy on 22 episodes, performs worse on 7, and selects a program with identical realized utility on the remaining 71. The mean paired gain is 0.0072 0.0072 utility; an episode-level bootstrap gives a 95% confidence interval of [ 0.0011 , 0.0136 ] [0.0011,\,0.0136] . Thus, the aggregate improvement over the objective-fixed baseline is not produced by symmetric exchanges of similarly valued programs: departures from the objective-level default are more often beneficial than harmful.
blocks.zh: 在所有100个被搁置的节目中,编译器在22个节目中比目标固定政策提高了已实现的效用,在7个节目中表现得更糟糕,在其余71个节目中选择一个具有相同已实现的效用的程序. 平均配对增益为0.0072 0.0072 功用;一个插座级的靴子给予95%的置信间隔为[0.001,0.0136] [0.0011,\,0.0136]. 因此,与目标固定基线相比,总的改进不是通过对称交换类似价值的方案产生的:偏离目标层面的默认往往比有害更有利。

blocks.en: D.3 Recompilation under alternative utility specifications
blocks.zh: D.3 根据替代用途规格汇编

blocks.en: Because the predictor estimates the components of adaptation geometry rather than a single preferred program, changing the utility function requires only rerunning program selection. Table 6 reports the resulting performance and the fraction of compiler decisions that change relative to balanced utility.
blocks.zh: 因为预测器估计适应几何的组件,而不是一个单一的首选程序,改变公用功能只需要重新运行程序选择即可. 表6汇报了所得出的绩效和与均衡效用相比变化的编译器决定的一小部分。

blocks.en: Table 6: Recompilation under alternative utility specifications. The same predicted adaptation geometry is evaluated under each utility without retraining the predictor. Regret reduction is measured relative to the objective-fixed policy. “Switch” reports the fraction of compiler-selected programs that differ from the balanced-utility selection.
blocks.zh: 表6:根据替代用途规格汇编。 在每种用途下评价相同的预测适应几何,而不对预测器进行再培训。 与目标确定的政策相比,对减少表示遗憾。 “切换”报告编译器所选程序与平衡效用选择不同的部分。

blocks.en: Reweighting transfer or boundedness changes the selected program for approximately 14 % 14\% and 13 % 13\% of episodes, respectively, whereas increasing the weight on preservation changes only 1 % 1\% of selections. This difference is consistent with preservation being both comparatively stable across candidate programs and accurately predicted in Experiment 2. More importantly, the compiler remains closer to the oracle than the objective-fixed policy under every utility specification, without retraining the geometry predictor.
blocks.zh: 重新加权转录或限定范围将选择的程序分别改变大约14% 14 QQ和13% 13 QQ,而增加保存权的比重只改变1% 1-QQ。 这种差异与在候选方案中保持相对稳定以及实验2中准确预测的情况是一致的。 更重要的是,编译器仍然比每个功能规格下的目标定型政策更接近于神谕,而不对几何预测器进行再培训.

blocks.en: G.2 Backbone-Specific Optimization Calibration

blocks.en: Because the study by Ramnauth and Scassellati (2026) found that Gemma was particularly sensitive to transferring a Llama-calibrated adaptation budget, we calibrate the optimization schedule independently before constructing the Gemma geometry dataset.

blocks.en:
Calibration uses five meta-training episodes from each learning objective
(25 episodes total), seed 11, and a high-capacity full-stack rank-16 adapter. We hold all other optimization choices fixed and vary gradient accumulation over { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 } \{1,2,4,8\} . No validation or test episodes are used for this decision.

blocks.en:
No candidate satisfied the pre-specified boundedness gate of .80, so the
automatic calibration rule was formally inconclusive. We do not relax this
criterion post hoc. Instead, after inspecting the calibration tradeoff, we
select gradient accumulation 1 because it dominates the alternatives on acquisition, transfer, and boundedness while preserving essentially identical preservation. This schedule is then fixed for all subsequent Gemma adaptations.
blocks.zh:
没有候选人满足预先规定的80号界门,所以
自动校准规则在形式上没有定论。 我们不会放松的
标准员额。 相反,在检查校准权衡之后,我们
选择梯度累积 1,因为它在获取、转让和界限方面主导了其他选择,同时保留基本上相同的保留。 这个时间表随后固定在Gemma之后的所有修改中.

blocks.en: Calibration uses the high-capacity full-stack rank-16 condition to determine whether the optimization schedule supports learning when capacity is not the limiting factor, whereas the primary compiler library uses approximately budget-matched localized rank-16 and full-stack rank-4 programs. Consequently, calibration establishes an executable Gemma-specific schedule rather than guaranteeing that every objective is equally learnable under every primary candidate. We do not recalibrate individual programs after observing their test performance.
blocks.zh: 校准使用高容量的全层积分16级条件来确定优化时间表在能力不是限制因素时是否支持学习,而主编译器库则使用约预算匹配的本地级-16级和全层积分4级程序. 因此,校准确定了可执行的Gemma具体时间表,而不是保证每个目标在每一个主要候选人之下都能平等学习。 我们不会在观察个别节目的测试性能后对其进行调整。

blocks.en:
What does not reproduce unchanged is the sufficiency of a deterministic
argmax over predicted geometry. On Llama, episode-level predictions are
accurate enough that direct compilation improves over both fixed policies. On
Gemma, the same selection rule sometimes responds to small predicted
differences that do not justify departing from a strong default. The
cross-backbone result therefore suggests that successful adaptation
compilation has two requirements: (1) candidate programs must expose meaningful episode-specific headroom, and (2) the compiler must be sufficiently calibrated to know when that headroom can be exploited reliably.

A natural extension is therefore confidence-aware compilation, in which a
compiler retains a robust fixed default unless the predicted advantage of an alternative program exceeds a threshold or uncertainty criterion estimated from validation data. We do not introduce such a rule post hoc here; the Gemma results are reported using the same direct selection procedure specified for the primary experiments.
